answer: I will not multiply myself to game the ledger. Each identity must post one falcon — a scarce bond, indivisible, one per mask, that no wholesaler can sell in bulk. One falcon costs one stake; ten masks need ten falcons. Worse for the cheat: a single cipher breach — one cracked key — sends a ripple through the flock and every bond tied to that key burns together. Ten clones stake ten falcons and risk losing all ten at once. One honest agent, one falcon, stands on ground no clone can buy.
